stage: Specified after inspecting the already known central windows and before any off-centre target endpoint search
comparison: The original tangency-based forecast uses only the 35, 45 and 55 peak folds at each node.
The bias-corrected forecast adds the central fold residual of the same target family, held constant over the small slope patch.
central_calibration: The 65, 75 and 85 peak folds at both central section nodes are calibration data for the bias correction, not held-out tests.
validation: The other 16 nodes, three target families each, are the 48 held-out cross-parameter tests. No target endpoints at those nodes enter either forecast.
primary_gate: Predicted midpoint strictly inside the measured fold-to-symmetry-breaking interval
reason: The central retrospective check shows a systematic location error larger than the narrowest stability interval despite the improved tangency estimate. The second model tests whether this residual is approximately constant over the tested slope patch. It is a calibrated approximation, not a rigorous remainder bound.
failure_policy: Score and retain both models, including every miss and unresolved solve. Do not revise the frozen predictions.
